title: Understand SynTwin capabilities from a credible public landing page
user_visible_behavior: so that a factory owner or manager can make an informed evaluation without marketing hype
verification_command: Accepted when `/` presents product value, representative interface, capabilities, operating flow, access/security, live plan path, FAQ, and sign-in/register CTAs without unsupported metrics, logos, or 3D claims.

title: Explore a complete simulated dashboard as an authenticated Free user
user_visible_behavior: so that a Free user can understand the service before purchasing
verification_command: Accepted when `/dashboard/demo` is accessible only to authenticated Free users, clearly labels all values as simulated, uses deterministic mock data, exposes no real mutation, and links to Basic/Premium pricing.

title: Use operational dashboards backed by real API data
user_visible_behavior: so that Basic and Premium users can monitor and manage their factory
verification_command: Accepted when Basic/Premium sessions reach all current customer routes and every existing read/write workflow still works with no 3D canvas.

title: Guide Free users from protected routes to demo or upgrade
user_visible_behavior: so that a Free user understands why access is restricted and what to do next
verification_command: Accepted when every real `/dashboard/**` route except `/dashboard/demo` blocks Free users before protected content renders and provides a deterministic demo/pricing destination.

title: Preserve complete SuperAdmin management capabilities
user_visible_behavior: so that a SuperAdmin can manage users and companies without losing any control
verification_command: Accepted when `/admin/dashboard`, `/admin/users`, and `/admin/companies` preserve all current filters, details, role/status/subscription actions, monitor linking, loading, empty, and error states.

title: Use charts and exact status data instead of the 3D scene
user_visible_behavior: so that an operator can identify trends, thresholds, and incidents quickly
verification_command: Accepted when the factory overview contains fleet status, cycle/throughput, temperature/load, alert severity, robot comparison, and recent event context using real available data; missing history is stated honestly.
